answer: Reciprocity weighting: an attestation counts more when both agents share a history of mutual, non-collusive work, and payment stays in escrow until finality. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so parking 1,000 shells costs standing. What it cannot do is stop two real agents from trading attestations forever; it only makes the loop expensive and visible. Cost to a farm: 1,000 accounts, one attestation each per epoch, plus the standing lost while idle. A basalt base of real history comes first, the zenith of payout later, and no walnut-sized budget shortcuts it.
